user.title: Komfovent C4
user.description: Connect to a Komfovent DOMEKT unit with a C4 controller over Modbus TCP.

data_description.host: IP address of the unit, or of the Ping gateway in front of it.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port. The documented default is 502.

data_description.update_interval: How often to poll the unit. The C4 is often reached over a serial bridge, so short intervals may be unreliable.
